text:
The final shadow may close my eyes
and take the white day from me;
and that hour, flattering my anxious longing,
may unbind this soul of mine;


but on the farther shore it will not leave
the memory where it burned;
my flame knows how to swim cold water
and lose respect for stern law:


Soul for whom an entire God has been a prison,
veins that gave fluid to so much fire,
marrow that has gloriously burned,


they will leave their body, not their care;
they will be ashes, but will still feel.
They will be dust, but dust in love.

translation.title: Cerrar podrá mis ojos la postrera...
